# LENS_* variables config.go reads that docker-compose.yaml's lens service does NOT forward (B7.2).
#
# Under compose each of these is unset in the lens process whatever .env says: .env feeds only
# ${VAR} substitution inside docker-compose.yaml. TestComposeForwardsEveryLensVarConfigReads fails
# on any read NOT listed here, so a new variable cannot repeat the trap; and it fails on a listed
# name that becomes forwarded or unread, so this list only shrinks.
#
# To make one settable in production: add `- NAME=${NAME:-}` to the lens environment: list (check
# first that config.go treats "" the same as unset for it) and delete its line here.

LENS_ANTIGAMING_AUTO_REVOKE_ENABLED
